description: Delete a file from your personal Canvas storage. Cannot be undone. Get file_id from list_my_files. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

name: delete_my_file
title: Delete My File
